survivingClaim: Format step only; no statement about zeros. In MS Prop. 2.1, hypothesis (2.2) can be replaced by: H_eta holomorphic on Re s > sigma_0, bounded on Re s >= 2, and ord_rho H_eta < ord_rho L at one zero within eps* of the supremum (Lemma U1, proved). With the normaliser of Lemma H and the format ASSUMED on levels G_(f_j), f_0 = 0, f_(j+1) = 6 f_j + 6, j < k (no source for j >= 1; none below 7/8 for j = 0): beta(0) <= max(sigma_0, 3/5 + (2/5)6^-k); with all levels, B <= sigma_0 or 4/7 <= B <= 3/5. The ladder argument yields nothing inside [4/7, 3/5] (not shown to be a limit of the format). A second normaliser condition via eta^sigma exists exactly when eta^6 != (eta^sigma)^6 (absent for 1, chi o N and all chi with chi^6 = (chi^sigma)^6). The step separates no control (Liouville, sign twists, THIN share the normaliser zeros; typical unimodular twists have a zero-free normaliser to 7/12).
obstruction: Hypothesis (2.2) fails only by exact resonance ord_rho H >= ord_rho L at a zero (Lemma U1). A ladder over levels f -> 6f + 6 gives beta(0) <= max(sigma_0, 3/5 + (2/5) 6^-k), relative to Lemma H and to the format hypotheses (F_j) on infinite-order targets alpha^f chi, which have no source for j >= 1 (and none below 7/8 for j = 0). With all levels the supremum is <= sigma_0 or in [4/7, 3/5], the fixed points of 6s - 3 and 4 - 6s; inside that window the needed input is a common-zero exclusion, not reachable by counting. The step is target-blind (Liouville, sign twists, THIN have the same normaliser zeros). Without the format for infinite-order targets the ceiling stays 2/3.
